dataset: NREL End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. Building Stock (ResStock)
weather_note: Actual Meteorological Year 2018 (real 2018 weather), same release/weather as the AL building.
hvac_heating: Non-Ducted Heat Pump / MSHP, SEER 14.5, 8.2 HSPF
hvac_cooling: Non-Ducted Heat Pump / Non-Ducted Heat Pump
selection_criterion: MA single-family detached, heat-pump heating (Ducted or Non-Ducted), heating fuel Electricity, ZERO fossil heating (natural gas + fuel oil + propane, incl. hp_bkup variants), annual electric heating and cooling both > 200 kWh, ranked by heating/cooling ratio ascending (most balanced first). Reproduce with scripts/select_hvac_building.py.
selection_rank_note: One of the heat-pump sensitivity set (486202, 286081, 274807) -- the three most balanced candidates. The building choice is reported as a sensitivity, not a single pick.
local_derivation: Full-year (12 months, 35040 rows, 15-min end-of-interval) six-column HVAC slice (HVAC_ELECTRIC_COLS) of the source per-building timeseries, re-saved via pandas.to_parquet. Unlike the AL file this is a full year, not a one-week slice.
timezone: US Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5), no DST. NOTE: build_hvac hardcodes utc_offset_hours=-6 for the AL building; a MA building needs -5.
obtained_by: Direct OEDI download of a building identified by scripts/select_hvac_building.py (not a fingerprint recovery).
caveats: PEAK DRIVER DIFFERS FROM THE AL BUILDING: this MA peak is WINTER / heat-pump-BACKUP-driven (electric-resistance strips on the coldest hours), whereas the AL building's 2.761 kW peak was SUMMER / COOLING-driven. The capacity cap therefore has a different physical meaning and falls in a different season in the two buildings.
Weather year amy2018: if paired with 2019 EIA carbon, the same +364d cross-year join as the AL building applies.
Heat pump is only ~1.4% of MA single-family-detached stock (MA is ~48% gas, ~40% oil); an electrification-forward case chosen for a dual-season electric HVAC load, not a representative MA dwelling.

Heating energy includes electric-resistance backup (heating_hp_bkup, heating_hp_bkup_fa), which nrel_to_jobs sums into the same hourly block as heat-pump heating; a block cannot be decomposed after the fact.
